headline: 克里斯布朗判賠千萬艾諾拉三評
context: R&B 歌手克里斯布朗（Chris Brown）被美國法院裁定須賠償前管家 Maria Avila 1,290 萬美元（約新台幣 4 億），她在 2020 年被布朗的看守犬嚴重咬傷，留下植皮手術與心理創傷。另外，Netflix 電影《Enola Holmes 3》評論出爐，Millie Bobby Brown 繼續主演，評論認為這個系列已逐漸失去動力。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Millie Bobby Brown returns, along with the creative team behind Adolescence, for an often thoughtful yet ultimately lesser threequel Despite the ever-increasing size and dominance of Netflix, the streamer has continued to struggle with its most obvious aim. While viewers might flock there for smooth-brained dating shows, tawdry true crime, Harlan Coben thrillers and junky romcoms, the platform is yet to be known for creating original movie franchises, the bread and butter of most old-fashioned Hollywood studios, for better or worse. The problem Netflix often faces is that to turn a big-budget bet into a cultural event, it requires more than a low-stakes click at home and a brief weekend’s worth of chatter. Big numbers might have met wannabe franchise-starters Red Notice and The Grey Man but a lack of real long-term interest has meant that sequels haven’t followed, while its most expensive film ever, the Chris Pratt vehicle The Electric State, sank with both audiences and critics. It’s why the success of last year’s KPop Demon Hunters, a genuine all-consuming juggernaut, was such an important win, even if the film technically started its life at Sony. A sequel is, of course, coming, although there always felt like something a little accidental about the first film’s transformation into pop culture phenomenon, as if no one quite knew just what they had on their hands. sources.summary: California jury sides with Maria Avila over 2020 attack that left her requiring skin grafts R&B star Chris Brown has been ordered to pay $12.9m in damages to a housekeeper who was mauled by a dog at one of his properties. Maria Avila was working at Brown’s house in Tarzana, California, in 2020 when she was attacked by Hades, a Caucasian shepherd used as a guard dog. At the trial in Van Nuys, California, Avila said she was left with serious injuries to her arm and face, requiring dozens of sutures and skin grafts from her abdomen to her arm. She said was also left with post-traumatic stress disorder, and nerve damage which made it difficult to work. Continue reading...

thread_text:
克里斯布朗判賠千萬艾諾拉三評

R&B 歌手克里斯布朗（Chris Brown）被加州法院裁定須賠償前管家 Maria Avila 1,290 萬美元（約新台幣 4 億）。Avila 在 2020 年於布朗洛杉磯豪宅工作時，被一隻高加索牧羊犬 Hades 嚴重咬傷，需要植皮手術，並留有神經損傷與創傷後壓力症候群。

Netflix 的《Enola Holmes 3》評論同步出爐。Millie Bobby Brown 繼續主演，劇情移師馬爾他。The Guardian 認為系列正在失去早期魅力；紐約時報的評論則相對寬容，說 Brown 的表現依然閃亮。

——本則整理自 The Guardian 與紐約時報於 2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

克里斯布朗判賠千萬艾諾拉三評

R&B 歌手克里斯布朗（Chris Brown）被判需賠償前管家 Maria Avila 1,290 萬美元。2020 年，Avila 在他的加州豪宅工作時，被看守犬 Hades（一隻高加索牧羊犬）嚴重咬傷，需要植皮手術，留有神經損傷和創傷後壓力症候群。

文化面，《Enola Holmes 3》評論出爐，Millie Bobby Brown 繼續主演，The Guardian 認為系列正在失去動力；紐約時報評論說仍是輕鬆的女主角戲。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與紐約時報於 2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
今天有兩件事。

R&B 歌手克里斯布朗（Chris Brown）被判賠 1,290 萬美元——大概是新台幣四億——給一名曾被他的狗嚴重咬傷的前管家。事情發生在 2020 年，Maria Avila 在他的加州豪宅工作時，被一隻高加索牧羊犬咬傷，需要植皮，留下了神經損傷和心理創傷。

《Enola Holmes 3》也上映了，Netflix 續集，Millie Bobby Brown 繼續主演，劇情移師馬爾他。The Guardian 說系列開始失去動力；紐約時報的評價相對溫和，說主演依然出色。
